newsitem.title: USA: Total Control prunes size of IPO.
newsitem.headline: Total Control prunes size of IPO.

text.p: Total Control Products Inc cut the number of shares in its initial public offering to 2.0 million from 2.75 million, according to a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday.
The price range was unchanged at $8 to $10 a share.
The shares are expected to be priced later Monday for trading the next day on the Nasdaq under the symbol "TCPS," according to Adams, Harkness & Hill, the lead underwriter.
Of the two million shares, 1.65 million will be sold by the company, with the remainder being offered by selling shareholders.
After the offering, directors, executive officers, principal shareholders and their families will own about 61.1 percent of the company, based in Melrose Park, Illinois.
Total Control develops technology used to control automated industrial equipment, such as the machinery used on factory floors.
